label: exploratory known-target, incomplete qrels, within L04, lexical caption-only baseline

authoring.source: Actual local images inspected with read; no caption or OCR text/ranks read before freezing this file.
authoring.selection_rule: Sort only dataset/data/L04/L04_V* directories; select zero-based video positions 0, floor((V-1)/3), floor(2*(V-1)/3), V-1. In each, sort *.jpg filenames and select zero-based positions floor((N-1)/3), floor(2*(N-1)/3). V=30. No replacement or extra images; previously inspected 040.jpg not included.
authoring.language_policy: English image-based scene phrases, with exact on-screen Vietnamese/name/number/date literals for three literal queries. Literal and scene subsets reported separately. This favors OCR for Vietnamese literals versus potentially English captions; not a language-controlled estimate.
authoring.freeze_policy: Write this file before reading caption/OCR target text or ranking; hash raw bytes in output. Do not revise based on results.
authoring.qrels_policy: One independently image-authored known target per query, keyed by video_id and keyframe_n (image stem n, not frame_idx). Other frames unjudged, not negatives; not self-retrieval or all-video relevance.
